summary: REE Automotive Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, disclosing the resignation of board member Rajesh Goel effective August 13, 2026. The resignation was immediate and not due to any disagreement with the company's operations, policies, or practices. No replacement, board recommendation, or advisors were mentioned. This is a routine director departure without dispute or strategic impact; while categorized as a management change, the filing is procedural. What to watch: whether a successor is named or further leadership shifts occur.
